description: Climbing teaches safe climbing, bouldering and rappelling: hazards and first aid, gear and grading, site safety, verbal signals, rope care and the essential knots, and climbing and rappelling under a qualified instructor.

safety.note: Climbing and rappelling follow Climb On Safely and require a qualified instructor.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The official page lists the topics in order, but the excerpts did not show clean numbering for the belaying, climbing and rappelling requirements, so those are not outlined yet.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
